P1: Use 冲浪 to sail eastward from 若叶镇 to reach 27号道路.
P2: 27号道路 is a seaside route that connects 若叶镇 in the west and 26号道路 in the east. The uneven terrain hinders eastbound travel, forcing Trainers to pass through 都城瀑布.
D2: Isolated bit of land east-southeast of Tohjo Falls (requires 冲浪)
D4: From an elderly woman in the house, if the lead party Pokémon is friendly enough
D5: Isolated bit of land south of the western bridge (requires 冲浪, 潮旋)
D6: Northeast of the eastern whirlpool, on the lowest cliff
D7: On the cliffside, next to the easternmost grass patch (hidden)
D8: Small shoreline on the route's east end, accessible via Route 26 (hidden; requires 冲浪)
D9: Northern of two rocks on the eastern ledge, accessible via Route 26 (hidden)
D10: Sometimes given out by Bird Keeper Jose, after registering his phone number
P3: When you step out of the water, you draw the attention of a man standing nearby. He asks if you know what you have just done, and excitedly informs you that you have just taken your first step into the Kanto region.
P4: 都城瀑布 is a small cave in southwest Kanto that serves to link the two regions together. As it cannot be cleared before obtaining 秘传学习器07（攀瀑） and the 升龙徽章, it also acts as a natural barrier so that only the strongest Trainers continue onward to the Pokémon League at 石英高原.
D11: West end of the path behind the two waterfalls (requires 冲浪, 攀瀑)
P5: Visit the house outside 都城瀑布 to meet an elderly woman. After hearing that you are headed to the Pokémon League, she asks if your Pokémon are loyal enough to you. If your lead Pokémon is friendly enough, she rewards you with 招式学习器37（沙暴）.
P6: 26号道路 is one of the longest routes in Kanto, and occupies much of the western part of the region. It stretches from 27号道路 in the far southwest to the Pokémon League Reception Gate that sits at the crossroads between 28号道路 to the west, 22号道路 to the east, and Victory Road to the north.
D12: Halfway through the route, on a tree northwest of the rest stop (daily)
D13: Northeast area, on the cliffside between two trees (hidden)
D14: Southwest of the gate and the northern-most pair of ledges
P7: Visit the house on the eastern road and speak to the woman inside. Noticing how tired that your Pokémon appear to be, she lets you take a moment to rest, restoring your Pokémon to full health in the process.
P8: The house on the edge of the grass patch in the southwest belongs to the Week Siblings. No one is home, but a note on the table lists each sibling's designated location. Each sibling gives out a different type-enhancing item. After all seven siblings have been met, they hand out Ribbons, as well.
P9: All Trainers traveling to 石英高原 must present their Badges to prove their worth. The first guard looks to see if a Trainer has earned all eight Badges from the Johto region. Once he has verified that you have earned every Badge, you are free to continue on. Two other men block the way to the west and east exits. Step through the doors to the north to enter Victory Road.
P10: Victory Road is a difficult tunnel separating the Pokémon League Reception Gate and 石英高原. It serves as a final test for aspiring Trainers to prove themselves, as only the strongest reach the other side.
D17:
* Southern of the two central ridges, west of the bridge (hidden)
* Between the two central ridges, under the south end of the bridge
D18: West-central area, one step south of three rocks along the wall (hidden)
D19: Northeast area, in the narrow passage littered with stones (requires 怪力)
D21: Southwest area, on a lone stalagmite between the first and second stairways (hidden)
D22: Southeast area, on the dark patch of ground (hidden)
D23: Northeast area, northwest of the boulder (requires 怪力)
D25: South; on the dark ground above the ledge (hidden)
D28: Southeast; on a stalagmite in the northeast corner (hidden)
D29: Northeast; northeast end of the central ridge
D30: Northeast; northeast end of the central ridge, behind a breakable rock (hidden; requires 碎岩)
D31: Northwest area, partially obscured behind a large stalagmite
D32: Northwest area, behind three breakable rocks in the middle of 3F (requires 碎岩)
P11: Go north and use 怪力 to move the boulder one step northward. Go down the southwest stairway, then turn around and head east to reach a 伤药. Climb the next stairway to cross the bridge, then walk down the stairway to the west. Pass under the bridge to reach a 万灵药, then turn west. Move northward to reach a narrow passage littered with stones; move the southern of the two boulders here to reach a 活力块. Go west and climb the northwest ladder.
P12: Go south and move eastward across the ridge. Climb up the eastern ladder.
P13: Jump down through the hole in the floor to return to 2F.
P14: Move northward to find a boulder sitting near several stairways. Use 怪力 to push it one step westward; this clears a path to the nearby 全复药. Push it back eastward to continue north and climb up the northeast ladder.
P15: Go south and pass by the hole in the floor. Turn west to climb onto the rocky ridge and collect an 高级球 near the north wall. Move southwest to find two more holes in the floor. Jump down through the northern one.
P16: Pick up the ＨＰ增强剂, then jump the ledge and climb up the ladder.
P17: Follow the tunnel northward to find two branching paths; go north from here and jump down through the hole in the floor.
P18: Walk down the stairway to the west to reach 招式学习器26（地震）. Moving the nearby boulder creates a shortcut to the cave entrance, if necessary. Climb back up the stairway, then climb the ladder back to 3F.
P19: Go east, jump the ledge, and head north. Pass by the hole in the floor to reach a 神奇糖果. Turn south, jump the second ledge, then use 碎岩 to reach 招式学习器79（恶之波动）. Take a moment to tend to your Pokémon, then move northward around the ridge again. The exit is a short distance to the north.
P20: Before you can reach the exit, 劲敌（西尔弗） appears once again. He asks if you are headed to the Pokémon League, and if you saw any other "real" Trainers in the cave. He implies that he defeated them all by calling them spineless, and admits that making it this far proves that you are not part of that group. He promises to end your journey here as well, and draws you into battle.
P21: Each of 劲敌（西尔弗）'s Pokémon has grown a few more levels since the last battle. His 小磁怪 has since evolved into 三合一磁怪, and the Pokémon that he took from Elm's lab has now evolved into its final form. He has recently added a 勇基拉 to his team, as well; as a 超能力 Pokémon, Kadabra has low physical 防御 and takes serious damage from 虫-, 幽灵-, and 恶 attacks.
P22: Afterward, Silver admits that he may need some time for self-reflection to figure out why he cannot defeat you. He reaffirms his intent to keep getting stronger, and looks forward to the day when he finally beats you. He tells you to keep training until then, and leaves. Exit the cave to arrive at 石英高原, the site of the Pokémon League.
